panels.description: Count of localization requests that produced pose estimates (detected via metrics JSON in localizer stdout)

targets.expr: count_over_time({service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"inlier_ratio"` [$__auto])

panels.title: Failed Localizations
panels.description: Count of localization errors (pose estimation failure, no keypoints, etc.)

targets.expr: count_over_time({service="localizer", container="app"} |~ `(?i)error|failed|traceback` [$__auto])
sum(count_over_time({service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"inlier_ratio"` [$__auto])) * 60 / $__interval_ms * 1000
sum(count_over_time({service="localizer", container="app"} |~ `(?i)error|failed` [$__auto])) * 60 / $__interval_ms * 1000

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM localization_maps WHERE active = true;

panels.title: Pose Estimation Quality (from localizer stdout via Loki)
Inlier Ratio Over Time
panels.description: Ratio of RANSAC PnP inliers to total correspondences. Higher is better (>0.5 is good, >0.8 is excellent). Extracted from localizer stdout JSON metrics.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"inlier_ratio"` | regexp `"inlier_ratio": (?P<inlier_ratio>[0-9.]+)` | unwrap inlier_ratio [$__auto]) by ()

panels.title: Reprojection Error Median (px)
panels.description: Median reprojection error of inlier correspondences in pixels. Lower is better (<2px is good, <1px is excellent). This measures how accurately the estimated pose reprojects 3D points onto the query image.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"reprojection_error_median"` | regexp `"reprojection_error_median": (?P<reproj_err>[0-9.]+)` | unwrap reproj_err [$__auto]) by ()

panels.title: Inlier Coverage
panels.description: Fraction of the query image covered by the convex hull of inlier correspondences. Higher coverage means the pose is constrained across more of the image. Low coverage (<0.2) suggests the match is concentrated in a small region.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"inlier_coverage"` | regexp `"inlier_coverage": (?P<coverage>[0-9.]+)` | unwrap coverage [$__auto]) by ()

panels.title: Feature Matching Pipeline (from localizer stdout via Loki)
Feature Matching Funnel
panels.description: The localization pipeline: LightGlue produces raw matches, filtering for valid 3D points gives correspondences, RANSAC PnP selects inliers. Each stage filters further. Healthy pipelines should show matches >> correspondences > inliers with stable ratios.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"num_matches"` | regexp `"num_matches": (?P<num_matches>[0-9]+)` | unwrap num_matches [$__auto]) by ()
avg_over_time({service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"num_correspondences"` | regexp `"num_correspondences": (?P<num_corr>[0-9]+)` | unwrap num_corr [$__auto]) by ()
avg_over_time({service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"num_inliers"` | regexp `"num_inliers": (?P<num_inliers>[0-9]+)` | unwrap num_inliers [$__auto]) by ()

panels.title: Correspondence Yield & Inlier Yield
panels.description: Correspondence yield = correspondences/matches (how many LightGlue matches have valid 3D points). Inlier yield = inliers/correspondences (RANSAC success rate). Both should be stable; drops indicate map quality degradation or environmental change.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"inlier_ratio"` | regexp `"inlier_ratio": (?P<val>[0-9.]+)` | unwrap val [$__auto]) by ()

panels.title: Inlier Ratio Distribution (last 24h)
panels.description: Histogram of inlier ratios across all localization attempts. The distribution shape indicates overall system health: a right-skewed distribution (peak near 1.0) means most localizations are excellent.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.1, {service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"inlier_ratio"` | regexp `"inlier_ratio": (?P<val>[0-9.]+)` | unwrap val [$__auto]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.5, {service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"inlier_ratio"` | regexp `"inlier_ratio": (?P<val>[0-9.]+)` | unwrap val [$__auto]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.9, {service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"inlier_ratio"` | regexp `"inlier_ratio": (?P<val>[0-9.]+)` | unwrap val [$__auto]) by ()

panels.title: Reprojection Error Distribution (last 24h)
panels.description: Percentiles of reprojection error (pixels). p50 < 2px is good. p90 < 5px means the tail is acceptable. Rising p90 with stable p50 suggests intermittent poor-quality localizations.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"reprojection_error_median"` | regexp `"reprojection_error_median": (?P<val>[0-9.]+)` | unwrap val [$__auto]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.9, {service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"reprojection_error_median"` | regexp `"reprojection_error_median": (?P<val>[0-9.]+)` | unwrap val [$__auto]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.99, {service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"reprojection_error_median"` | regexp `"reprojection_error_median": (?P<val>[0-9.]+)` | unwrap val [$__auto]) by ()

panels.title: Match Count Distribution
panels.description: Percentiles of raw LightGlue match counts. If p10 is very low (<10), some query images are barely matching the map, possibly due to viewpoint change, lighting, or occlusion.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.1, {service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"num_matches"` | regexp `"num_matches": (?P<val>[0-9]+)` | unwrap val [$__auto]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.5, {service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"num_matches"` | regexp `"num_matches": (?P<val>[0-9]+)` | unwrap val [$__auto]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.9, {service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"num_matches"` | regexp `"num_matches": (?P<val>[0-9]+)` | unwrap val [$__auto]) by ()

panels.title: Localizer Error Stream
panels.description: Raw error logs from the localizer service. Watch for patterns: 'No matching keypoints' = poor image quality or map mismatch, 'Pose estimation failed' = insufficient correspondences for RANSAC.

targets.expr: {service="localizer", container="app"} |~ `(?i)error|failed|traceback|exception|no matching`

panels.title: Reconstructor Error Stream
panels.description: Raw error logs from the reconstructor. 'Reconstruction failed, no model was created' = COLMAP SfM could not build a 3D model.

targets.expr: {service="reconstructor", container="app"} |~ `(?i)error|failed|traceback|exception`

panels.title: Quality Classification (literature thresholds from Sattler et al CVPR 2018, Sarlin et al CVPR 2019)
Inlier Ratio Quality Bands
panels.description:
Classification of localization quality based on RANSAC inlier ratio. Thresholds from visual localization benchmark literature:
- Excellent (>0.5): Strong geometric consensus, reliable pose
- Acceptable (0.3-0.5): Moderate consensus, pose likely correct but less confident
- Poor (0.2-0.3): Weak consensus, high chance of incorrect pose
- Critical (<0.2): Near-random, pipeline degradation likely

Per Sarlin et al (CVPR 2019), inlier ratio is the primary diagnostic for RANSAC PnP quality. At >50% outlier ratio, even LO-RANSAC degrades significantly.

targets.expr: last_over_time({service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"inlier_ratio"` | regexp `"inlier_ratio": (?P<val>[0-9.]+)` | unwrap val [$__auto]) by ()

panels.title: Inlier Count Quality Bands
panels.description:
Absolute inlier count per localization query. Thresholds from literature:
- Robust (>30): Well-constrained pose, sufficient for P3P+RANSAC
- Marginal (12-30): Minimum for reliable pose, sensitive to outlier distribution
- Critical (<12): Below minimum for P3P, pose estimation unreliable

Per the Image Matching Challenge (2021-2024), minimum 12 correspondences are needed for geometric verification. Below this, RANSAC cannot reliably distinguish inliers from outliers.

targets.expr: last_over_time({service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"num_inliers"` | regexp `"num_inliers": (?P<val>[0-9]+)` | unwrap val [$__auto]) by ()

panels.title: Degradation Cascade Monitoring (per Sattler et al, failure modes propagate downstream)
Feature Matching Pipeline Health
panels.description:
The localization pipeline has three stages that cascade: matches → correspondences → inliers. This panel shows the ratios between stages, which diagnose WHERE failures originate.

- Low correspondences/matches = many LightGlue matches lack valid 3D points in the map (map coverage gap or stale map)
- Low inliers/correspondences = RANSAC rejecting most correspondences (viewpoint change, moving objects, or wrong retrieval)

Per the degradation cascade model from Sattler et al (CVPR 2018): low-texture → fewer features → fewer matches → low inliers → pose failure. The first ratio to degrade identifies the pipeline bottleneck.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"num_matches"` | regexp `"num_matches": (?P<val>[0-9]+)` | unwrap val [$__auto]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.5, {service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"num_correspondences"` | regexp `"num_correspondences": (?P<val>[0-9]+)` | unwrap val [$__auto]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.5, {service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"num_inliers"` | regexp `"num_inliers": (?P<val>[0-9]+)` | unwrap val [$__auto]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.1, {service="localizer", container="app"} |= `"num_inliers"` | regexp `"num_inliers": (?P<val>[0-9]+)` | unwrap val [$__auto]) by ()
